overview.text: Today's developments span security applications, reasoning architectures, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure scaling. Anthropic previews data on using Claude for automated attack surface reduction in large open-source codebases to improve software security. In reasoning and modeling, new research explores parallel reasoning with draft refinement in diffusion models, spatio-temporal video grounding for long-form event reasoning, and the failure modes of external memory in LLM agents where more memory can degrade performance. Additional studies examine progress-aligned recurrence for length generalization, real-time playable game worlds using video models, and omni-modal GUI agents processing streaming observations. Model releases include baidu/Unlimited-OCR and abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-Quantized, alongside git-ai designed for AI agents. Evaluation and infrastructure are further represented by FairStress for assessing fairness in LLM decision-making, SimReady Central for 3D assets, and industry analysis on datacenters projecting significant acceleration and capacity growth.

entries.title: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code
entries.summary: Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can meaningfully improve the security of deployed software in the near term. In this post, we preview data we’ve collected from applying attack surface reduction techniques to large open-source codebases using Claude.
entries.why: Shows how Claude automates attack surface reduction to meaningfully improve deployed software security.

entries.title: Breaking Diffusion: Parallel Reasoning with Draft Refinement
entries.summary: Drafting an answer allows a reasoning model to reconsider each decision in the context of the others. Yet repeated diffusion denoising does not ensure that individually plausible token updates form a better answer together.
entries.why: Examines parallel reasoning and draft refinement to improve diffusion model answer generation.

entries.title: Event-STVG: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding for Long-Form Event Reasoning
entries.summary: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to jointly localize a target in space and time given a natural-language query.
entries.why: Addresses spatio-temporal video grounding for complex long-form event reasoning tasks.

entries.title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
entries.summary: LLM agents can improve across tasks without updating model parameters by storing experience from their own executions in external memory and reusing it to guide later decisions.
entries.why: Reveals how external memory can sometimes degrade LLM agent performance instead of helping.

entries.title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
entries.summary: Looped language models can run more iterations at test time, but additional iterations need not help them solve longer problems.
entries.why: Investigates progress-aligned recurrence to help looped language models achieve length generalization.

entries.title: Matrix-Game 4.0: Harnessing Video Models for Real-Time Playable Game Worlds
entries.summary: Moving from controllable videos to genuinely playable worlds requires persistent world state, executable game rules, and low-latency interaction.
entries.why: Harnesses video models to build real-time playable game worlds with persistent states.

entries.title: Focused Omni-Modal GUI Agents
entries.summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents increasingly act over streaming omni-modal observations spanning screenshots, audio, video, interaction history, and device states.
entries.why: Analyzes focused omni-modal GUI agents acting over diverse streaming device observations.

entries.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
entries.why: Provides a popular image-text-to-text transformer model for OCR tasks.

entries.title: abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-Quantized
entries.why: Offers a quantized text-to-image model variant for local deployment workflows.

entries.title: feder-cr/git-ai
entries.summary: Git designed for AI agents. · Go
entries.why: Introduces a new git tool specifically designed for AI agents.

entries.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
entries.summary: FairStress is a new benchmark that reveals demographic differences in how LLMs defend and explain their decisions, even when their final choices appear fair.
entries.why: Exposes hidden demographic biases in LLM decision-making explanations through a new benchmark.

entries.title: Announcing SimReady Central: An Open Library of Simulation-Ready 3D Assets for Robotics and AI Factories
entries.why: Supplies an open library of simulation-ready 3D assets for robotics and AI factories.

entries.title: Anthropic Does Not Understand Why Its Draft Bill Was Unacceptable and Troubling
entries.summary: Anthony Cimino offered the closest thing to an official response we have seen on the leaked Anthropic draft bill I covered on Saturday.
entries.why: Analyzes the official response surrounding a leaked draft bill involving Anthropic.
